title: Eugene F. Fama — Efficient Capital Markets: II (December 1991)
use: Opening methodological discussion of information-set categories, costs and the joint hypothesis between efficiency and an asset-pricing model. Original chapter derives its own conditional pricing and probability examples.
verification: Opened the actual 43-page Journal of Finance article in the Boston University teaching archive; inspected sections I-II and beginning of III, printed pages 1575-1578. Official Wiley metadata confirms December 1991, volume 46 issue 5, pages 1575–1617. Historical return estimates, later event-study numerical findings and current empirical conclusions are not adopted; source-wide empirical verification is not claimed.

title: Sanford J. Grossman and Joseph E. Stiglitz — On the Impossibility of Informationally Efficient Markets (June 1980)
use: Scoped primary theoretical context for costly information, imperfect revelation by prices and incentives to acquire information. The chapter's capped fixed-quote signal problem is original and not claimed as the paper's equilibrium.
verification: Opened the actual 17-page scan including cover; read the introduction and model discussion on printed pages 393–395, including the paper's limitation of its demonstrated results to its specified example. Also inspected the CARA/model setup for context, without claiming to reproduce appendix proofs. University of Maryland copy opened but supplied no extracted body; the cited PIMS copy provided readable actual article text. No unconditional impossibility theorem for all markets or empirical result is attributed.

title: Andrei Shleifer and Robert W. Vishny — The Limits of Arbitrage (March 1997)
use: Primary theoretical context for capital requirements, interim losses and delegated funding in convergence trading. Chapter develops its own identical-claim collateral ledger with exact fee timing and explicitly restricted rights.
verification: Opened and inspected the actual 21-page Journal of Finance article, introduction and agency discussion on printed pages 35–41. Harvard author's publication page independently confirms the 1997 article and links its PDF; that attachment had no extracted text, so the readable Stanford teaching copy is the cited body. No source numerical trading example, full equilibrium reproduction, estimated withdrawal function or claim of present empirical importance is adopted.
